candidate_merges.message: Update Aspire.Cli to target net11.0 (#20436) ## Description This retargets the Aspire CLI from `net10.0` to `net11.0`, with only the changes needed to build, publish Native AOT, package, and pass tests. Follow-up PRs will start using new .NET 11 features. ### User-facing impact - **Nothing changes in behavior for users of the native `aspire` binary.** - **The `Aspire.Cli` dotnet tool package layout changes.** The platform-specific packages (`Aspire.Cli.<rid>`) now put the binary under `tools/any

Remove redundant experimental annotations from Azure Sandboxes (#20482) ## Description Consumers should not need to suppress `ASPIREAZURE001` to use Azure Sandboxes: the entire `Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Sandboxes` package is already prerelease. Remove the `Experimental` attributes for `ASPIREAZURE001` from the sandbox resource, extension methods, options, and enums. Remove obsolete warning suppressions and unused imports, including the suppression in the README and generated deployment-test AppHost.
